events.verdict: Booker (PHX) initiates contact with Ayton's (POR) arm, which affects his play at the basket.
Nurkic (POR) is slightly late to firm up while establishing himself in Henderson's (POR) path and marginal lower body contact occurs during the pick.
Booker (PHX) reaches across Brogdon (POR) and initiates contact with his body, which affects Brogdon's SQBR as he crosses midcourt.
Nurkic (PHX) moves alongside Simons' (POR) path and maintains a legal guarding position during the driving shot attempt.
Grant (POR) contests the shot attempt at the rim and avoids making contact with Allen's (PHX) head.
Allen (PHX) avoids contact with Simons' (POR) arm on his dislodge attempt during the driving shot attempt.
Grant (POR) moves alongside Durant's (PHX) path and maintains a legal guarding position as incidental contact occurs during the driving shot attempt.
Ayton (POR) reaches for the ball and marginal contact occurs as he brushes Booker's (PHX) arm when he starts his dribble in transition.
Grant's (POR) left arm makes contact with Durant's (PHX) right arm on his way to the ball and the illegal contact affects Durant's play at the basket.
Nurkic (PHX) retracts his arm and adjusts to Grant's (POR) path as marginal contact occurs when they briefly come together as Grant starts his dribble on the perimeter.
Nurkic's (PHX) right hand initiates contact with Grant's (POR) left arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Nurkic (PHX) blocks the shot out of bounds and possession is correctly retained by the Trail Blazers.
Allen (PHX) maintains a legal guarding position during the drive and shot attempt by Simons (POR).
Brogdon (POR) contests the jump shot attempt and avoids making contact with Durant's (PHX) arm.
Henderson (POR) reaches for the loose ball and marginal follow-through contact occurs with Nurkic's (PHX) arm after Nurkic taps the rebound to himself.
Grant (POR) legally contests Allen's (PHX) jump shot attempt.
